notes: kb/Work PB5244 landed. §1985:XIII.3.10.10 GR1 a.: after a page footing on the same page the report footing's first line can be no earlier than "one greater than the final LINE-COUNTER setting established by the page footing report group", otherwise FOOTING + 1; b.: on a page by itself, the HEADING integer. ReportSectionBinder.GroupLimits computes the report-footing limits once (the NEXT PAGE first line: HEADING; with a page footing: below 2002 Cobol85FinalLineCounter of the page footing, its NEXT GROUP integer, its last line plus its NEXT GROUP PLUS integer, or its last line, per §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR5; from 2002 the line after its last line, §2002:13.16.55.3 GR7 g); with none: FOOTING + 1), and ScreenReportGroupLines refuses an absolute line outside them (COBOL2199). Witnesses: 1985-GR-XIII_3_10_10-1, pb5244_report_footing_after_page_footing_next_group (PF LINE 17 NEXT GROUP 19, RF LINE 20: runs) and pb5244_report_footing_above_page_footing_next_group (PF NEXT GROUP PLUS 2, RF LINE 18: refused at 85).

next.reason: 1985 a: after a page footing on the page the report footing's upper limit is 'one greater than the final LINE-COUNTER setting established by the page footing' (which includes the PF's NEXT GROUP, XIII.3.10.9 GR5a,b), else FOOTING+1; b: NEXT PAGE -> HEADING. 2023 §2023:13.18.57.4 GR7 g) 'is the line following the last line of the page footing, if specified', or FOOTING+1 (also §2023:13.18.39.4 GR2 'begins after this line'); f) and §2023:13.18.39.4 GR4 keep HEADING for an RF on a page by itself. The PF's NEXT GROUP no longer raises the limit, so absolute RF lines between the PF's last line and its NEXT GROUP line become legal: looser.
